content.summary: Stocks rose Friday after fresh jobs data showed U.S. unemployment ticked down in December and a potential Supreme Court ruling on tariffs failed to pan out.  Vistra  stock surged 11% and  Oklo  jumped 7.9% after the nuclear energy companies unveiled separate agreements to provide power to  Meta Platforms  in order to support the hyperscaler’s data-center campus in Ohio.  Meta inched up 1.1%.

content.title: Merck in Talks to Buy Revolution Medicines for Around $30 Billion
content.summary: Merck  is in talks to acquire  Revolution Medicines  in a deal that could value it at around $30 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.  A deal for the cancer-drug biotech could come as soon as later this month, the people said, cautioning the talks could still fall apart or another suitor could prevail.  Merck has been discussing a deal valued between $28 billion and $32 billion, the people added.
